register.info: Registers you to start in the next game. Can not be used when a game is ongoing.

move.info: Gameplay command. Move 1 square. This action costs 1 AP.

donate.info: Gameplay command. Give 1 AP to a player within reach of you.

attack.info: Gameplay command. Attack a player within reach. This action costs 1 AP.

expand.info: Gameplay command. Permanently increase your reach by 0.5. This action costs 1 AP.

confirm.info: Lock in gameplay actions or settings changes. Once confirmed, these actions can not be cancelled.

set.info: Change gameplay settings. Can only be executed by a game owner.

create.info: Starts a new game. Players can use !register <game id> to join this game until the first tick.

leave.info: Leaves your current game. Your AP will be distributed to players within your reach.
